### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Restrict subjective symptoms to those explicitly reported by the patient in their history of present illness (HPI). Do not infer subjective complaints from objective physical exam findings or patient reactions during the exam.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Subjective symptoms must originate solely from the patient's verbal statements describing their experience (HPI). Do not include findings or reactions observed or elicited during the physical examination, even if confirmed by the patient.
